objectives: Check decoding and encoding of short-/u/ CVC words.
Route learners to targeted remediation based on component evidence.
concepts: A diagnostic samples multiple related skills.
Fluency depends on accurate decoding plus connected reading.

definitions.definition: An assessment used to identify strengths, needs, and the next instructional step.
Accurate, appropriately paced, connected reading with meaning.
A score representing performance in one specific skill area.

workedExamples: If a learner misses /u/ recognition items, route to sound-recognition practice.
If a learner reads cup as cop, route to short-/u/ decoding.
If a learner decodes accurately but cannot answer where questions, route to comprehension.
If decoding is accurate but reading is very hesitant, route to fluency.
commonMistakes: Treating all errors as the same problem.
Rushing through the diagnostic without reading carefully.
Guessing a word from context instead of decoding.
Confusing accurate word reading with fluent connected reading.
keyTakeaways: Use error evidence to choose support.
Do not reteach mastered components unnecessarily.

basic: Review short-/u/ sound, decoding, encoding, and literal comprehension.
application: Interpret sample errors and identify the appropriate support.
higherOrderThinking: Use multiple evidence points to distinguish decoding from fluency or comprehension needs.
mixedReview: Combine short-/u/ recognition, word reading, spelling, comprehension, and fluency decisions.

quickRevision: Recognize → decode → encode → comprehend → read fluently.
formulaOrFactBank: Targeted remediation = component evidence → specific practice
mistakeBasedRevision: Name the skill behind an error before choosing remediation.
weakTopicRevision: Repeat the item type for the weakest component, then reassess with fresh items.

activities.name: Fluency check
steps: Read a short controlled passage aloud.

rules: If soundRecognition < 0.8, route to short-/u/ sound recognition review.
If decoding < 0.8, route to targeted short-/u/ decoding.
If encoding < 0.8, route to targeted short-/u/ spelling.
If comprehension < 0.8, route to controlled sentence/passage comprehension.
If fluency < 0.8, route to controlled rereading and fluency practice.
If all components >= 0.8, route to reassessment/next-pattern readiness.

outcomes: Learner demonstrates short-/u/ decoding and encoding.
System can route the learner to component-specific remediation.
